name: InVideo
summary: Turns a prompt or script into a first-draft video with AI voiceover, templates and stock footage. Plans are priced per seat and metered in monthly credits that do not roll over.
best_for: marketing teams and creators who want to turn a prompt or script into a publish-ready first-draft video fast, using templates, AI voiceover and stock
skip_if: you need frame-level creative control, long-form or highly bespoke production, or your usage would blow past the monthly credit allowance
honest_knock: The honest catch is the credit model: each plan is a fixed monthly credit allowance that different models consume at different rates, and unused credits do not roll over, so a heavy month can exhaust an allowance long before it renews while a slow month simply wastes what you paid for. The pricing page lists no free tier, but on 22 November 2026 a new account opened on a Free plan with 50 credits; in our test one prompt used 26.4 of them and the voiceover still needed a paid plan. AI video is fast but generic by default: templated output needs real editing and brand direction to not look like everyone else's. Treat it as a first-draft engine, not a finished-studio replacement.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per seat a month on either billing term (400 credits/seat/mo, up to 5 seats)
pricing.notes: Three plans priced per seat, re-verified on invideo.io/pricing on 24 September 2026; the page was rebuilt after 5 September, when it listed Plus, Max, Generative and Elite. Starter is $20 a seat a month on either billing (400 credits a seat a month, up to 5 seats), Plus $50 a seat annually or $60 monthly (2,000 credits, up to 10 seats) and Max $100 a seat annually or $150 monthly (5,000 credits, up to 20 seats; 10,000- and 15,000-credit sizes are offered but not priced in the served page). Storage is 200 GB, 600 GB and 2,000 GB; Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0 at 4K start on Plus. Credits are the meter: AI generations draw them down, timeline editing and downloads do not, the allowance resets each billing cycle without rollover, and extra credit packs are sold separately. No free tier is published on the pricing page, although a new account opened on a Free plan with 50 credits on 22 November 2026 and a cancelled plan drops to it.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 22 November 2026 in the InVideo web app on the Free plan, with the interface in English. We gave the agent one prompt for a 30 second vertical video with stock footage, an English voiceover and captions, read the credit meter before and after, and stopped at the upgrade screen. We paid nothing.
findings: Free plan: a new account opened on a Free plan with 50 credits, no iStock allowance and 10 GB of storage. The usage page said the allowance resets on 23 November; we did not check how often it resets after that.
Script: from one prompt the agent (Agent Two Lite) wrote a short script with three numbered tips, on screen text beats and a shot plan in about a minute.
Stock: it picked 12 vertical stock clips and a music bed. Premium iStock clips were not available on the Free plan, so it switched to free stock.
Voiceover: the English voiceover did not run. The agent reported a plan limit and showed an upgrade card, so no video was cut or exported.
Credits: that single attempt took the meter from 0 to 26.4 of 50 credits, although nothing was rendered. Check the usage page before you retry.

Prices on 22 November 2026 from a Netherlands connection, during a Black Friday sale: Starter €10 a seat a month billed yearly (€20 normally), Plus €30 (€60 normally), and Max €62.50 a seat a month on a two year deal.
